message.content:
The user now needs to send a text message. There is an SMS button (send button) in the lower right corner of the interface, corresponding to the element [872, 570, 988, 620]. Clicking this button will send the message. Therefore, perform the Tap action to click the send button and complete the sending operation. It is important to ensure the button is in an active state; the current interface shows the button as clickable, so the action will be executed.


do(action="Tap", element=[940,605])
